place.zh: 沉鼎山 · 后山崖顶 · 草屋
place.en: Mount Chending · The cliff top · a thatched hut

setup.zh: 崖顶一间草屋，屋前青石上一只香炉，三根香已经点上了。瞿老摸出一张红纸：拜师帖，只空着一个名字。
setup.en: A thatched hut on the cliff top; on a blue stone before it, an incense burner with three sticks already lit. Elder Qu takes out a sheet of red paper: a letter of discipleship, one name left blank.

recap.zh: 后山崖顶的草屋前，你在瞿老的拜师帖上写下了名字；他对着崖外上告祖师，你三拜九叩。他四十多年没收过徒弟。
recap.en: Before the thatched hut on the clifftop you wrote your name on Elder Qu's discipleship letter; he reported to the founders out over the cliff, and you made the three bows and nine knocks. He had taken no disciple in more than forty years.

zh: 崖顶一间草屋。三根香，已经点上了。
屋门口一块青石，扫得一片落叶也没有。
en: A thatched hut on the cliff top. Three sticks of incense, already lit.
A bluestone by the door, swept clean of every leaf.

text.zh: 红纸上的字一笔到底，像扫帚扫出来的；只空着写名字的那一处。
text.en: The characters on the red paper run each in one stroke, as if swept with a broom. Only the place for a name is blank.

text.zh: 三根香已经点上了，烧下去小半截——倒像早就知道你会来。
text.en: The three sticks of incense are already lit and have burned a little way down — as if he knew all along you would come.

text.zh: 屋檐下挂着一把旧扫帚，比山门那把还秃。
text.en: An old broom hangs under the eaves, balder even than the one at the gate.

story.zh: 崖顶上一间草屋，屋门半掩着，里头一张竹床，一张木桌，桌上两只茶杯，一只杯口朝上，杯底剩着半口冷茶；另一只杯口朝下扣着，扣得端端正正，落了厚厚一层灰，像很多年没人翻过来了。屋门口一块青石，扫得一片落叶也没有，石上一只香炉，三根香已经点上了，仿佛早就知道他会来。
story.en: On the top of the cliff stood a grass hut, its door half open. Inside, a bamboo bed, a wooden table, and on the table two teacups. One stood mouth up, with half a mouthful of cold tea left in the bottom. The other was turned mouth down, set square and precise, under a thick layer of dust, as if nobody had turned it over in many years. At the hut's door was a bluestone, swept so clean there wasn't a single fallen leaf on it, and on the stone a censer with three sticks of incense already lit, as if it had been known all along that he'd come.

label.zh: 在旁边的石头上刮了刮鞋底，再踏上去
label.en: Scrape your soles on a stone to the side, then step on

exits.means: scrapes his soles clean before stepping onto the swept bluestone, as he did on the steps on the ninth of the ninth month

story.zh:
小满走到青石跟前，脚下一顿，把脚抬起来，在旁边的石头上刮了刮鞋底，刮干净了，才踏上去。瞿老道：「九月初九那天，在台阶上，你也刮过。三千多个孩子从我扫的台阶上踩过去，刮了鞋底再踩的，两个。」小满问：「还有一个是谁？」瞿老没有答。

他在青石边上坐下：「外门弟子，没有师父。法不传六耳，一个师父一辈子只教得好几个人。想要师父，得有人要你。」他从怀里摸出一张红纸，放在青石上，是一张拜师帖，字已写好，只空着一个名字，「我四十多年没收徒弟了。你写不写，自己定。」
story.en:
Xiaoman walked up to the bluestone, stopped short, lifted his foot and scraped the sole on a stone to the side, scraped it clean, and only then stepped onto it. Elder Qu said: "On the ninth of the ninth month, on the steps, you scraped them too. More than three thousand children have walked over the steps I sweep. Those who scraped their soles before they stepped: two." Xiaoman asked: "Who was the other one?" Elder Qu didn't answer.

He sat down at the edge of the bluestone: "Outer disciples don't have a master. The way is not passed to six ears; in a lifetime a master can only teach a few people well. If you want a master, someone has to want you." He took a sheet of red paper from his robe and laid it on the bluestone: a discipleship card, the words already written, only a name left blank. "I haven't taken a disciple in more than forty years. Whether you write it or not, decide for yourself."

refuse.en: At the bluestone, you stop short.

story.zh:
小满走到青石跟前，抬脚便踏了上去。瞿老看了他的脚一眼，什么也没说。

他在青石边上坐下：「外门弟子，没有师父。想要师父，得有人要你。」他从怀里摸出一张红纸，是一张拜师帖，只空着一个名字，「我四十多年没收徒弟了。你写不写，自己定。」
story.en:
Xiaoman walked up to the bluestone and stepped straight onto it. Elder Qu glanced at his feet and said nothing.

He sat down at the edge of the bluestone: "Outer disciples don't have a master. If you want a master, someone has to want you." He took a sheet of red paper from his robe: a discipleship card, only a name left blank. "I haven't taken a disciple in more than forty years. Whether you write it or not, decide for yourself."

label.en: Write your name, and bow three times

exits.means: signs the letter of discipleship and bows

what.zh: 瞿老四十多年没收徒弟。他收了你。
what.en: Elder Qu had taken no student in more than forty years. He took you.

story.zh:
小满拿起笔，在空着的地方写上了自己的名字，写得比哪一回都端正。

瞿老站起身，就着旧香的火点了三根新香，对着崖外——云雾底下是泗水，泗水边上是沉鼎观的正殿——站直了身子：「沉鼎观第十一代弟子瞿某，今收徒一人，徐州蒙山沈氏，名小满。上告祖师。」他说得很慢，像在念一张很旧的单子。念完了，望着崖外的云，低低地道：「……四十多年前，在这块石头跟前，也说过一回。」小满没听清：「师父说什么？」瞿老道：「没什么。跪下。」小满三拜九叩，又冲着祖师的方向磕了三个头。瞿老那只手，在他肩膀上按了一下，按得很重。

瞿老把一卷薄薄的书扔给他：「内功，《黄庭经》。先背熟了。」小满翻开来，头一句便是「玉池清水灌灵根」，抬起头来：「师父，这上头也讲灵根？」瞿老道：「《黄庭经》{典=huangting-linggen}里的灵根，是舌头底下那口津，人人都有。」
story.en:
Xiaoman took up the brush and wrote his own name in the blank space, more carefully than he had ever written it.

Elder Qu stood up, lit three new sticks of incense from the old ones, and faced out beyond the cliff (below the clouds and mist was the Si, and by the Si the main hall of the Sunken Cauldron Abbey), and stood up straight: "Qu, disciple of the eleventh generation of the Sunken Cauldron Abbey, today takes one disciple: Shen, of Mount Meng in Xu Province, named Xiaoman. Reported above to the founder." He said it slowly, like reading out a very old list. When he had finished, he gazed at the clouds beyond the cliff and said low: "...More than forty years ago, in front of this stone, I said it once before." Xiaoman didn't catch it: "What did you say, Master?" Elder Qu said: "Nothing. Kneel." Xiaoman made the three kneelings and nine knockings, then knocked his head three more times towards the founder. Elder Qu's hand pressed down on his shoulder once, very hard.

Elder Qu tossed him a thin scroll of a book: "Inner work. The *Yellow Court Classic*. Learn it by heart first." Xiaoman opened it, and the very first line was "The clear water of the jade pool waters the spirit root." He looked up: "Master, it talks about spirit roots here too?" Elder Qu said: "The spirit root in the *Yellow Court Classic*{典=huangting-linggen} is the spittle under the tongue. Everyone has one."

refuse.zh: 青石跟前，你还站着——先踏上去。
refuse.en: You are still standing at the bluestone — step onto it first.

_beats: 古六 (the per-回 plan, 2026-10-15): 刮鞋底 is a choice, not a board — the story stops at the swept bluestone; 刮 (the book's) or 直接踩 (a branch the book never took: he steps on, 瞿老 says nothing). 瞿老's 「九月初九那天，在台阶上，你也刮过……两个」 is said only to a boy who did scrape on the steps: 古三's `steps-steady` (00-gate's steady way, whose passage scrapes) — when 古三's 登 board lands with its own `sole-scraped`, read that mark here instead. Either choice hides both (`caowu-stone`), and the 拜师帖 waits on it.
